liner.body_md:
## The recordings

- **gd1995-01-01.EarthquakeCountrysessions.sbeok.97111.shnf** (recommended): source not stated; 9 songs; 65 min; rated 3.36/5 by 11 [1]. Said about its sound: Recording has a psychedelic edge with spaced-out backup vocals and excellent Jerry Garcia performance; Tracks sound like overdriven FM board recordings with sustained bass distortion drowning out crowd noise; Unique backup singing and harmonies suggest a studio version, though audience noise is audible [2][4][6]

## Around the show

- Reviewer notes the absence of Samba in the Rain and wonders about the album title [10]
- Listener considers this recording far superior to the album Built to Last [2]
- A few selections from this recording appear on the So Many Roads box set [5]
- Reviewer calls this song the lowest point in the band's career and a misfire [11]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1995-01-01.EarthquakeCountrysessions.sbeok.97111.shnf**: transferred by Julian Fowler; source: See info file [1]. Also: Reviewer questions if the compilation was made by the band or a fan picking versions; These are from the band's final attempts to record an album of new material; Julian Fowler obtained a 1997 cassette copy from a newsgroup tree run [1][3][5]
